summary: Thirteen capabilities in four groups: teaching and course delivery (learning management, live classroom interaction, courseware authoring, tutoring, simulation training), assessment, administration (student information, special education, career guidance, assistive technology), and keeping knowledge (libraries, archives and museums, scholarly search and dictionaries). The breakdown follows 1EdTech and ADL interoperability standards for delivery and assessment, Ed-Fi and CEDS for administration, MARC, IFLA LRM and NISO standards for libraries, and EAD, Spectrum and OAIS for archives and museums; ISCED levels were used only to check that early childhood, school, postsecondary and workforce training are all covered.

capabilities.name: Learning management and course delivery
capabilities.definition: Given courses, enrolled learners and learning content, deliver the content, track participation and progress, and record results.

crosswalk.label: Applied computing > Education > Learning management systems

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Learning management and course delivery'. Academic and corporate learning management are one function; corporate compliance tracking is kept as its own task because its inputs (job roles, regulatory requirements) differ.

tasks.name: Packaged course content playback
tasks.definition: Given a content package and an enrolled learner, launch and sequence the package and record completion, time and score.
tasks.inputs: content package (SCORM, Common Cartridge, cmi5), learner enrollment
tasks.outputs: rendered lessons, completion status, scores, time on task
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: conformance test suites exist for SCORM and Common Cartridge, but nothing scores delivery quality

tasks.name: External learning tool launch
tasks.definition: Given a course context and an external learning tool, launch the tool with the user's identity and role and return its grades to the course.
tasks.inputs: course and user context, tool registration, signed launch request
tasks.outputs: authenticated tool session, grade and roster passback
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: 1EdTech certification tests check protocol conformance only

tasks.name: Course gradebook calculation
tasks.definition: Given assignment scores, category weights, drop rules and a grading scheme, compute running and final course grades.
tasks.inputs: scores, weights, late and drop policies, grading scale
tasks.outputs: per-student course grades and grade reports
tasks.benchmarkable: no: deterministic arithmetic under local rules; only correctness against the rules can be tested

tasks.name: Course discussion and question answering
tasks.definition: Given course members and course materials, host threaded discussion and questions, with answers endorsed by instructors.
tasks.inputs: course roster, posts, course materials
tasks.outputs: threaded discussions, endorsed answers, participation records
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automatic answering of course questions could be scored against instructor answers; no public benchmark is standard

tasks.name: Lecture capture and video lessons
tasks.definition: Given recorded lectures, publish them with synchronized slides, captions, in-video search and viewing analytics.
tasks.inputs: lecture audio, video and slides
tasks.outputs: searchable captioned video, viewing statistics
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: caption word error rate and slide-text search are measurable; teaching value is not

tasks.name: Required training assignment and tracking
tasks.definition: Given job roles, regulatory training requirements and completion records, assign required courses, track due dates and expiring certifications, and report compliance.
tasks.inputs: employee roles, training requirements, course catalog, completion records
tasks.outputs: assignments, overdue and expiry alerts, compliance reports
onet_products: Cobent Learning and Compliance Suite LCS
PRO-ductivity Systems Compliance Training Manager Web
Hazardous waste operations and emergency response standard HAZWOPER training software
tasks.benchmarkable: no: rule-driven record keeping; correctness is conformance to the organization's rules
tasks.notes: Straddles enterprise HR; see open questions.

tasks.name: Learning activity records and analytics
tasks.definition: Given streams of learner activity statements, store them and compute engagement measures and predictions such as course completion.
tasks.inputs: activity statements (actor, verb, object, result), course structure
tasks.outputs: learning record store, engagement dashboards, completion predictions
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: completion and outcome prediction on public data such as the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset and KDD Cup 2015 MOOC dropout data

capabilities.name: Live classroom interaction
capabilities.definition: Given a teacher-led session and learners' devices, present activities, collect responses and student work in real time, and show results.

crosswalk.label: Applied computing > Education > Interactive learning environments

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Classroom instruction and engagement tools'. Renamed to the function (live interaction). Lesson planning moved to courseware authoring.

tasks.name: Live polling and quiz games
tasks.definition: Given a set of questions, collect answers from learners' devices during a session and display aggregated results or a leaderboard.
tasks.inputs: questions, live participants
tasks.outputs: per-question response distributions, scores, leaderboard
tasks.benchmarkable: no: response collection; there is no computed answer to score

tasks.name: Teacher-paced interactive lessons
tasks.definition: Given slides with embedded questions and activities, push each slide to students' devices in step with the teacher and collect responses per slide.
tasks.inputs: slide deck with embedded activities, student roster
tasks.outputs: synchronized lesson, per-slide student responses
tasks.benchmarkable: no: delivery and collection only

tasks.name: Interactive video lessons
tasks.definition: Given a video and questions placed at timestamps, play it to learners, pause for the questions, and record answers and viewing completion.
tasks.inputs: video, timed questions
tasks.outputs: learner answers, viewing completion
tasks.benchmarkable: no: delivery task; generating the questions belongs to test item authoring

tasks.name: Student work portfolios
tasks.definition: Given student work captured as photos, video, audio or text, organize it into per-student portfolios with teacher feedback and share it with families.
tasks.inputs: student artifacts, rubrics or comments
tasks.outputs: per-student portfolios, feedback, family-visible journal
tasks.benchmarkable: no: record keeping and sharing

capabilities.name: Instructional design and courseware authoring
capabilities.definition: Given learning goals, standards and source content, design a course and produce reusable, packaged learning content.
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Courseware and e-learning authoring'. Added curriculum mapping and standards alignment (from the classroom seed) because they are design work upstream of authoring.

tasks.name: Curriculum mapping and standards alignment
tasks.definition: Given learning standards and a course's units, lessons and assessments, align each to the standards it addresses and report coverage and gaps.
tasks.inputs: standards frameworks, course units, lessons, assessments
tasks.outputs: curriculum map, alignment links, coverage report
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automatic alignment of items or lessons to standards can be scored against expert-labelled alignments; whole-course design cannot

tasks.name: Interactive e-learning module authoring
tasks.definition: Given content, interactions and quiz items, produce a self-paced module with navigation, branching and tracking, published as a standard package.
tasks.inputs: text, media, interaction templates, quiz items
tasks.outputs: SCORM, xAPI or HTML5 package
onet_products: Learning Technology Research Institute GLO Maker
Center for Computer-Assisted Legal Instruction CALI Author
tasks.benchmarkable: no: output quality is a pedagogical judgment; only package conformance is testable

tasks.name: Software demonstration and simulation capture
tasks.definition: Given recorded screen actions in an application, produce step-by-step demonstrations and practice simulations that check the learner's clicks and entries.
tasks.inputs: screen recording, captured actions
tasks.outputs: watch, try and test simulations
tasks.benchmarkable: no: authoring task without a reference output

tasks.name: Learning content management and reuse
tasks.definition: Given learning objects with metadata, store, version and search them and assemble them into courses and multiple output formats.
tasks.inputs: learning objects, metadata, templates
tasks.outputs: content repository, assembled courses, multi-format outputs
onet_products: Xyleme Learning Content Management System LCMS
Telania eLeaP Learning Management System LMS/LCMS
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: metadata generation and search over learning objects can be scored on labelled repositories; no standard leaderboard

capabilities.name: Assessment, testing and academic integrity
capabilities.definition: Given test content and learner responses, build and deliver assessments, score them, estimate ability and check the integrity of the work.
onet_categories: Optical character reader OCR or scanning software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Assessment, testing and grading; academic integrity'. Split into authoring, delivery, adaptive testing, calibration, machine scoring and integrity tasks; curriculum-based screening added from the special education seed because it is used for all students.

tasks.name: Test item authoring and banking
tasks.definition: Given content standards and source material, write, review, tag and store test items with their statistics, exchanged in a standard item format.
tasks.inputs: standards, source passages, item templates
tasks.outputs: reviewed, tagged items with statistics; QTI exports
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automatic question and distractor generation is scored on datasets such as SQuAD-derived question generation and RACE, with weak metrics

tasks.name: Secure test delivery and proctoring
tasks.definition: Given a test form and candidates, deliver a timed test in a locked-down environment, monitor for misconduct and record responses.
tasks.inputs: test form, candidate list, timing and accommodation rules
tasks.outputs: response records, misconduct flags, session logs
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: misconduct detection from video and keystrokes could be scored on labelled sessions; few public datasets exist

tasks.name: Computerized adaptive testing
tasks.definition: Given a calibrated item bank and a test blueprint, select items one at a time to estimate the examinee's ability to a target precision.
tasks.inputs: calibrated item bank, blueprint constraints, responses
tasks.outputs: ability estimate with standard error, administered item sequence
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: simulation against known true abilities gives exact accuracy, efficiency and item-exposure measures

tasks.name: Item analysis and test calibration
tasks.definition: Given scored response matrices, estimate item parameters, reliability, score equating and differential item functioning.
tasks.inputs: scored response matrix, examinee groups
tasks.outputs: item parameters, reliability, equating tables, bias flags
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: parameter recovery on simulated data with known parameters
tasks.notes: Psychometrics is kept here because it is specific to tests; general statistics stays in science.

tasks.name: Answer sheet scanning and scoring
tasks.definition: Given scanned answer sheets and a key, read the filled marks and score each sheet.
tasks.inputs: scanned bubble sheets, answer key
tasks.outputs: read responses, scores, item statistics
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: mark-reading accuracy against sheets with known marks

tasks.name: Automated essay and short-answer scoring
tasks.definition: Given written responses and a rubric or reference answers, predict the scores human raters would assign and give feedback.
tasks.inputs: student responses, rubric, scored training responses
tasks.outputs: predicted scores, trait feedback
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: the Hewlett ASAP essay and short-answer datasets (quadratic weighted kappa) and SemEval-2013 Task 7

tasks.name: Text similarity and plagiarism detection
tasks.definition: Given a submitted document and a corpus of sources and prior submissions, find copied or paraphrased passages and report their sources.
tasks.inputs: submitted text or code, reference corpus
tasks.outputs: matched passages with sources, similarity score
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: PAN shared tasks on text reuse and plagiarism detection provide corpora and scores

tasks.name: Screening and progress monitoring
tasks.definition: Given short timed probes repeated over time, score them and track each student's growth against norms and goals.
tasks.inputs: probe responses or recordings, norms, goals
tasks.outputs: scores, growth charts, risk flags
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automatic scoring of oral reading fluency from audio can be checked against human words-correct-per-minute counts

capabilities.name: Student information and school administration
capabilities.definition: Given students, staff, courses and institutional rules, keep official student records and run enrollment, scheduling, grading, aid and reporting.

crosswalk.label: Postsecondary Electronic Standards Council transcript standards

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Student information and school administration'. Covers early childhood through postsecondary (ISCED 0 to 8). General finance, HR and payroll of a school stay in enterprise.

tasks.name: Enrollment, attendance and student records
tasks.definition: Given applications, registrations and daily attendance, maintain each student's demographic, enrollment, program and attendance record and roster students to classes.
tasks.inputs: applications, registration data, attendance marks
tasks.outputs: student records, class rosters, attendance rates and absence flags
onet_products: SunGard Higher Education Banner Unified Digital Campus
Student and Exchange Visitor Information System SEVIS
tasks.benchmarkable: no: record keeping whose correctness is conformance to data standards

tasks.name: Course timetabling
tasks.definition: Given course requests, teachers, rooms and periods, build a master schedule and student timetables that minimize conflicts.
tasks.inputs: course requests, staff and room availability, constraints
tasks.outputs: master schedule, student and teacher timetables, conflict report
onet_products: High School Scheduling and Transcript HSST
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: International Timetabling Competition instances (2007, 2019) with scored solutions

tasks.name: Grade reporting and transcripts
tasks.definition: Given final course grades and credit rules, compute grade point averages and class rank and produce report cards and official transcripts.
tasks.inputs: course grades, credit values, grading scales
tasks.outputs: report cards, transcripts, electronic transcript exchange
onet_products: High School Scheduling and Transcript HSST
tasks.benchmarkable: no: deterministic computation under local rules

tasks.name: Degree audit and transfer credit evaluation
tasks.definition: Given program requirements, a student's completed courses and incoming transfer work, determine which requirements are met and which course equivalencies apply.
tasks.inputs: program rules, academic history, transfer transcripts, equivalency tables
tasks.outputs: audit report, remaining requirements, equivalency decisions
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: rule evaluation can be checked against registrar decisions; matching course descriptions for equivalency can be scored on labelled pairs

tasks.name: Student financial aid packaging
tasks.definition: Given cost of attendance, need analysis results and fund rules, compute each student's aid package and track disbursement.
tasks.inputs: need analysis records, cost of attendance, fund rules and budgets
tasks.outputs: award packages, award letters, disbursement schedules
onet_products: SunGard Higher Education Banner Financial Aid
tasks.benchmarkable: no: rule computation under regulation

tasks.name: Early warning of dropout
tasks.definition: Given attendance, behavior and course-performance histories, predict which students are at risk of failing or leaving and flag them for support.
tasks.inputs: attendance, discipline and grade histories
tasks.outputs: risk scores and flags
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: dropout and failure prediction on public data such as the UCI Student Performance dataset, scored by AUC

tasks.name: Advising and tutoring visit tracking
tasks.definition: Given student appointments and walk-in visits to advising, tutoring and counseling services, schedule them, record notes and report usage.
tasks.inputs: appointment requests, staff availability, visit notes
tasks.outputs: schedules, visit records, usage reports
tasks.benchmarkable: no: scheduling and record keeping

tasks.name: Education data reporting and exchange
tasks.definition: Given local student, staff and assessment records, validate them and submit them to state and federal systems in standard formats.
tasks.inputs: local records, reporting specifications
tasks.outputs: validated submissions, error reports
onet_products: Student and Exchange Visitor Information System SEVIS
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: conformance to Ed-Fi or Common Education Data Standards schemas is testable

capabilities.name: Special education planning
capabilities.definition: Given evaluations of a student with a disability, plan, document and monitor individualized instruction and services under special education law.

crosswalk.label: Common Education Data Standards: special education elements

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was the planning half of seed 'Special education, individualized plans and assistive technology'. Assistive technology split out because it serves any reader or writer with a disability, not only students.

tasks.name: Individualized education program management
tasks.definition: Given evaluation results, eligibility and present levels of performance, draft goals, services and accommodations and track meeting and compliance deadlines.
tasks.inputs: evaluations, eligibility determination, present levels, service options
tasks.outputs: individualized education program document, service schedule, compliance alerts
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: goal measurability and compliance checks could be scored against expert review; no public dataset

tasks.name: Tiered intervention tracking
tasks.definition: Given screening results, assign tiered interventions, log intervention sessions and graph progress against goals.
tasks.inputs: screening scores, intervention catalog, session logs
tasks.outputs: intervention plans, progress graphs, decision flags
onet_products: Special Education Student Information System SESIS
tasks.benchmarkable: no: plan and record keeping

tasks.name: Classroom behavior observation recording
tasks.definition: Given an observation protocol, record time-sampled or event behaviors and compute behavior rates and inter-observer agreement.
tasks.inputs: observation codes, sampling scheme
tasks.outputs: behavior rates, agreement statistics, graphs
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automated behavior coding from video can be scored against human coders

capabilities.name: Assistive reading and writing technology
capabilities.definition: Given text or an interface that a person with a disability cannot use in its usual form, convert it to an accessible form or reduce the effort of producing text.

crosswalk.label: Assistive products for communication and information management

onet_categories: Optical character reader OCR or scanning software
capabilities.notes: Split from seed 'Special education, individualized plans and assistive technology'. ISO 9999 class 22 drove the breakdown. Speech dictation is left to general speech recognition.

tasks.name: Text-to-speech reading support
tasks.definition: Given digital or scanned text, read it aloud with synchronized highlighting and study aids.
tasks.inputs: documents, web pages or scanned pages
tasks.outputs: synthesized speech with word highlighting, annotations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: speech quality is rated by listeners (mean opinion score) and recognition of scanned pages by character error rate

tasks.name: Screen reading
tasks.definition: Given a running user interface, convert on-screen content and focus changes into speech or braille with keyboard navigation.
tasks.inputs: accessibility tree of the running interface
tasks.outputs: speech and braille output, navigation commands
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: conformance to accessibility interfaces is testable; navigation efficiency needs user studies

tasks.name: Screen magnification
tasks.definition: Given the screen image and focus, magnify and re-color the region of interest and track the pointer and caret.
tasks.inputs: screen image, focus events
tasks.outputs: magnified, contrast-adjusted view
tasks.benchmarkable: no: display transformation without a reference output

tasks.name: Braille translation
tasks.definition: Given print text and a braille code, produce contracted braille formatted for embossing or a refreshable display.
tasks.inputs: print text or documents, braille code and formatting rules
tasks.outputs: formatted braille files
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: output can be compared with reference transcriptions; liblouis maintains expected-output test suites

tasks.name: Word prediction for writing
tasks.definition: Given partially typed text, propose the next words or corrections to reduce keystrokes and spelling errors.
tasks.inputs: typed context, user vocabulary
tasks.outputs: ranked word suggestions
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: keystroke savings on held-out text

tasks.name: Symbol-supported communication boards
tasks.definition: Given vocabulary and a symbol set, produce picture-symbol communication boards and visual schedules.
tasks.inputs: vocabulary, symbol library, layout
tasks.outputs: printable or on-screen symbol boards
tasks.benchmarkable: no: design of materials without a reference output
tasks.notes: Speech-generating devices used in therapy belong to health.

capabilities.name: Tutoring and adaptive practice
capabilities.definition: Given a learner's responses over time, model what they know and choose, check and explain the next practice so they learn.

crosswalk.label: Applied computing > Education > Interactive learning environments

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Tutoring, adaptive practice and language learning'. Kept, with language learning as one task; cognitive and perceptual therapy programs handed to health.

tasks.name: Learner knowledge tracing
tasks.definition: Given a learner's sequence of attempts on skill-tagged items, estimate mastery of each skill and predict correctness on the next attempt.
tasks.inputs: attempt logs with item-skill mapping
tasks.outputs: per-skill mastery estimates, next-response predictions
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: ASSISTments, EdNet and KDD Cup 2010 datasets with AUC leaderboards

tasks.name: Drill-and-practice exercises
tasks.definition: Given a skill area and the learner's level, present practice items, score answers and adjust difficulty.
tasks.inputs: item pool, learner level
tasks.outputs: practice sequence, scores, mastery report
onet_products: American Printing House for the Blind Talking Typer
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: difficulty calibration can be scored by prediction of learner accuracy; learning gains need trials

tasks.name: Step-based intelligent tutoring
tasks.definition: Given a multi-step problem and the learner's steps, check each step and give hints and error-specific feedback.
tasks.inputs: problem, solution model, learner steps
tasks.outputs: step correctness, hints, feedback
onet_products: Almaris E-Learning Systems Financial Accounting Tutor
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: step checking and hint quality can be scored on tutoring datasets such as MathDial; learning gains need trials

tasks.name: Conversational tutoring
tasks.definition: Given a learner's question and course context, conduct a dialogue that guides the learner to the answer without giving it away.
tasks.inputs: learner utterances, course materials, problem
tasks.outputs: tutor turns
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: the BEA 2025 shared task and MathDial score tutor responses on pedagogical criteria

tasks.name: Spaced-repetition review scheduling
tasks.definition: Given flashcards and each learner's review history, schedule the next review of each card to maximize long-term retention.
tasks.inputs: cards, review log with outcomes
tasks.outputs: review schedule, recall-probability estimates
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: recall prediction on public review logs, such as the open spaced-repetition benchmark and Duolingo's half-life regression data

tasks.name: Computer-assisted language learning
tasks.definition: Given a learner's spoken or written production in a target language, score it, correct errors and select the next exercise.
tasks.inputs: learner speech or text, target-language curriculum
tasks.outputs: corrections, pronunciation scores, exercise sequence
onet_products: Computer assisted language learning CALL software
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: grammatical error correction (BEA-2019 shared task) and pronunciation scoring (speechocean762) have public leaderboards

tasks.name: Reading and foundational skills practice
tasks.definition: Given a learner reading aloud or completing phonics and comprehension exercises, detect errors and adapt the practice.
tasks.inputs: learner audio or responses, leveled texts
tasks.outputs: error reports, fluency measures, next texts
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: oral reading miscue detection can be scored against annotated recordings

capabilities.name: Simulation-based training
capabilities.definition: Given a model of a task environment and a training scenario, let learners practice in the simulation and score their performance.

crosswalk.label: Applied computing > Education > Interactive learning environments

capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Simulation-based and immersive training'. Modeled by what is simulated; the physics engines behind them belong to simulate.

tasks.name: Vehicle operator simulator training
tasks.definition: Given a vehicle model, an environment and a training scenario, run the simulator and score the operator's control and decisions.
tasks.inputs: vehicle dynamics model, scenario, trainee inputs
tasks.outputs: performance scores, event logs, replay
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: scenario scoring is defined per curriculum; no cross-simulator benchmark exists

tasks.name: Virtual laboratories
tasks.definition: Given a modeled experiment, let learners set variables, run trials and observe simulated results as they would in a real laboratory.
tasks.inputs: experiment model, learner choices
tasks.outputs: simulated observations, lab records
onet_products: Cengage Learning Sniffy the Virtual Rat
tasks.benchmarkable: no: fidelity is judged per experiment and learning effect needs trials

tasks.name: Classroom market and economics games
tasks.definition: Given a market or game design, run it with students as traders or players and report outcomes against theory.
tasks.inputs: game or market rules, participants
tasks.outputs: trades, payoffs, outcome charts
tasks.benchmarkable: no: classroom activity; there is no reference answer
tasks.notes: Research use of the same tools for experiments belongs to science.

tasks.name: Threat image projection training
tasks.definition: Given screening images and a library of threat images, inject fictional threats into live screening and score whether operators detect them.
tasks.inputs: baggage images, threat image library, operator responses
tasks.outputs: detection and false-alarm rates per operator
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: operator detection rates are scored; automated detection has public X-ray datasets such as SIXray and GDXray

tasks.name: Branching scenario role-play
tasks.definition: Given a decision tree of situations, present choices and consequences to the learner and score and debrief the path taken.
tasks.inputs: scenario graph, scoring rules
tasks.outputs: learner path, score, debrief
tasks.benchmarkable: no: authored content without a reference output

tasks.name: Immersive procedural skills training
tasks.definition: Given three-dimensional models of equipment and a procedure, train the procedure's steps in virtual or augmented reality and track errors.
tasks.inputs: equipment models, procedure steps, trainee actions
tasks.outputs: step errors, completion time, proficiency record
tasks.benchmarkable: no: metrics are specific to each procedure

capabilities.name: Library management and cataloging
capabilities.definition: Given a library's holdings, patrons and suppliers, describe the holdings, make them findable, and run acquisitions, circulation and resource sharing.

crosswalk.label: Information systems > Information systems applications > Digital libraries and archives

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Library systems and cataloging'. Broken down by the modules of an integrated library system and the standards each implements (MARC formats, NCIP, ILL, OpenURL).

tasks.name: Bibliographic cataloging
tasks.definition: Given an item, create or copy a bibliographic record with description and access points that conforms to the cataloging rules.
tasks.inputs: item or its metadata, cataloging rules, shared catalog records
tasks.outputs: bibliographic record in MARC 21 or BIBFRAME

crosswalk.label: Information Retrieval: Application Service Definition and Protocol

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: automatic metadata extraction from title pages or e-books can be scored against existing records

tasks.name: Subject indexing and classification
tasks.definition: Given a document, assign subject headings and a classification number from a controlled vocabulary.
tasks.inputs: document text or metadata, vocabulary or classification scheme
tasks.outputs: subject headings, class numbers

crosswalk.label: Guidelines for the Construction, Format, and Management of Monolingual Controlled Vocabularies

tasks.benchmarkable: yes: SemEval-2025 Task 5 (subject tagging with library vocabularies) and BioASQ semantic indexing with MeSH have leaderboards

tasks.name: Authority control and name reconciliation
tasks.definition: Given name and subject headings in records, match them to authority records and normalize the headings.
tasks.inputs: headings in bibliographic records, authority files
tasks.outputs: linked and corrected headings, new authority records
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: entity matching can be scored against gold links between authority files; no standing leaderboard

tasks.name: Circulation and patron management
tasks.definition: Given patrons, items and loan rules, process checkouts, returns, holds, renewals, fines and notices, including self-service machines.
tasks.inputs: patron records, item records, loan policies
tasks.outputs: loan transactions, holds queues, notices, fines
onet_products: PrimaSoft PC Small Library Organizer Pro
tasks.benchmarkable: no: rule-driven transaction processing

tasks.name: Acquisitions and serials control
tasks.definition: Given selection decisions, budgets and vendor data, order and receive materials, predict and check in serial issues, claim missing issues and prepare binding.
tasks.inputs: orders, fund budgets, vendor catalogs, publication patterns
tasks.outputs: purchase orders, receipts, serial check-in records, claims, invoices
onet_products: Houchen Bindery Library Automated Retrieval System LARS
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: serial issue prediction from publication patterns is checkable; the rest is transaction processing

tasks.name: Interlibrary loan and resource sharing
tasks.definition: Given a patron request for an item the library lacks, find libraries that hold it, route the request and track lending and delivery.
tasks.inputs: patron request, union catalog holdings, lending policies
tasks.outputs: routed requests, delivery and return tracking
tasks.benchmarkable: no: workflow and messaging between libraries

tasks.name: Electronic resource management and link resolution
tasks.definition: Given licenses, a knowledge base of electronic holdings and a citation, track entitlements, resolve the citation to full text and report usage.
tasks.inputs: licenses, holdings knowledge base, citation or OpenURL, usage reports
tasks.outputs: full-text links, entitlement records, usage statistics

crosswalk.label: The OpenURL Framework for Context-Sensitive Services

tasks.benchmarkable: partly: link-resolution accuracy can be scored against known holdings

tasks.name: Library catalog discovery
tasks.definition: Given a patron's query, search the catalog and article indexes and return ranked holdings with facets and availability.
tasks.inputs: query, catalog and article index, availability data
tasks.outputs: ranked results with facets and availability
onet_products: Library of Congress E-resources Online Catalog
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: relevance can be scored with judged queries, but no public library-catalog test collection is standard

capabilities.name: Archives and museum collections
capabilities.definition: Given archival records, museum objects and digital materials, describe, preserve and publish them and help people find them.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: New capability, not a seed. The scope 'keep knowledge' covers archives and museums, and O*NET lists many archivist and curator tools; they do not fit library cataloging because their units are collections and objects, not published items.

tasks.name: Archival arrangement and description
tasks.definition: Given an accession of records, arrange it in a hierarchy and write a finding aid that conforms to descriptive standards.
tasks.inputs: accession records, folder lists, creator information
tasks.outputs: finding aids in EAD, collection-level records
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: generated descriptions could be scored against archivist-written ones; no public benchmark

tasks.name: Museum collections management
tasks.definition: Given the objects in a collection, record their descriptions, locations, condition, rights, loans and exhibitions.
tasks.inputs: object records, location moves, condition reports, loan agreements
tasks.outputs: catalog of objects, movement history, loan and exhibition records
tasks.benchmarkable: no: record keeping

tasks.name: Digital preservation
tasks.definition: Given digital objects, ingest them into an archival store, identify and validate formats, check fixity, migrate at-risk formats and record preservation metadata.
tasks.inputs: digital files, submission agreements
tasks.outputs: archival information packages, preservation metadata, fixity reports
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: format identification and validation can be scored on corpora such as Govdocs1

tasks.name: Digital collection publishing
tasks.definition: Given digitized items and their metadata, host searchable online collections with image delivery and metadata harvesting.
tasks.inputs: digitized images and files, descriptive metadata
tasks.outputs: online collection site, image service, harvestable metadata
tasks.benchmarkable: no: hosting and publishing

tasks.name: Web archiving
tasks.definition: Given seed addresses and scope rules, crawl and capture websites into archive files and replay them as they were.
tasks.inputs: seed URLs, scope and frequency rules
tasks.outputs: WARC files, replayable captures
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: capture completeness can be measured by comparing replay with the live page

tasks.name: Historical document transcription
tasks.definition: Given scanned manuscripts or historical printed pages, segment the layout and transcribe the text.
tasks.inputs: page images
tasks.outputs: transcribed text with layout
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: ICDAR handwritten text recognition competitions give character error rates on public historical collections
tasks.notes: General optical character recognition belongs to computing or science; this task is the historical-script case.

tasks.name: Archival and union catalog discovery
tasks.definition: Given a research topic, search finding aids and collection records across many repositories and return the collections likely to hold relevant material.
tasks.inputs: query, aggregated finding aids and collection records
tasks.outputs: ranked collections and repositories
onet_products: National Union Catalog of Manuscript Collections (NUCMC)
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: retrieval over finding aids could be scored with judged queries; no standard test collection

capabilities.name: Scholarly search, reference works and dictionaries
capabilities.definition: Given a research question, find, screen, cite and measure the scholarly and reference literature.
onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Was seed 'Reference, bibliographic and research-information tools'. Domain-specific references (legal, clinical, financial) handed to their domains; this node keeps general scholarly and reference work. Dictionary and sign-language lookup were planned as a separate capability with translation; translation, translation memory and terminology management went to media (media.language.*) by agreement, and the two lookup tasks joined reference works here.

tasks.name: Bibliographic database search
tasks.definition: Given a research question, search abstracting and indexing databases with controlled vocabulary and return relevant citations.
tasks.inputs: query, database selection, vocabulary terms
tasks.outputs: ranked citations with abstracts and links
onet_products: EBSCO Information Services Academic Search Premier
Association for Computing Machinery Digital Library
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: TREC test collections such as TREC-COVID and TREC Genomics score scholarly retrieval

tasks.name: Literature screening for systematic reviews
tasks.definition: Given search results and inclusion criteria, rank or classify citations for inclusion so reviewers screen fewer records.
tasks.inputs: citations with abstracts, inclusion criteria, reviewer decisions
tasks.outputs: ranked or labelled citations, recall estimates
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: CLEF eHealth technology-assisted review tasks and the SYNERGY dataset

tasks.name: Citation analysis and bibliometrics
tasks.definition: Given a set of publications and their citation links, compute citation counts, impact indicators and maps of research fields.
tasks.inputs: publication records, citation links
tasks.outputs: indicators, rankings, co-citation and co-authorship maps
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: author-name disambiguation and citation classification have public benchmarks; the indicators themselves are definitional

tasks.name: Reference management and citation formatting
tasks.definition: Given citations gathered from databases and documents, store and deduplicate them and format citations and bibliographies in a chosen style.
tasks.inputs: citation records, PDFs, citation style
tasks.outputs: reference library, formatted in-text citations and bibliographies
tasks.benchmarkable: yes: metadata extraction from PDFs and citation-string parsing are scored against gold metadata (GROBID evaluations, the CORA citation set)

tasks.name: Reference work lookup
tasks.definition: Given a topic or term, retrieve authoritative entries from encyclopedias, handbooks and directories.
tasks.inputs: query
tasks.outputs: reference entries
onet_products: Online Dictionary for Library and Information Science ODLIS
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: open-domain question answering over reference works (Natural Questions over Wikipedia) is scored

tasks.name: Full-text corpora for humanities research
tasks.definition: Given a curated corpus of texts, support concordance, word-frequency and n-gram queries and passage retrieval.
tasks.inputs: corpus, query terms or patterns
tasks.outputs: concordances, frequency series, passages
onet_products: University of California Thesaurus Linguae Graecae TLG
tasks.benchmarkable: no: corpus services whose value is the curation

tasks.name: Electronic dictionary lookup
tasks.definition: Given a word or phrase, return its senses, definitions, pronunciations and equivalents in other languages.
tasks.inputs: headword or phrase, dictionary selection
tasks.outputs: entries with senses, examples and translations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: word-sense disambiguation and definition modelling benchmarks test sense selection

tasks.name: Sign language dictionary lookup
tasks.definition: Given an English word or a recorded sign, return the matching signs with video and their meanings.
tasks.inputs: word or sign video
tasks.outputs: sign videos and glosses
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: isolated sign recognition benchmarks such as WLASL score video-to-gloss lookup

capabilities.name: Career guidance and education planning
capabilities.definition: Given a person's interests, abilities, history and goals, assess them, match them to occupations and programs, and track a plan to get there.

crosswalk.label: Common Education Data Standards: workforce domain

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: New capability, not a seed: school and career counselors are an education occupation with a distinct set of tools in the grab-bag categories.

tasks.name: Career interest and aptitude assessment
tasks.definition: Given responses to interest, values and aptitude inventories, score them and suggest matching occupations and fields of study.
tasks.inputs: inventory responses
tasks.outputs: profile scores, ranked occupations and programs
onet_products: Coin Educational Products Climb K-5 Online
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: occupation recommendations could be scored against later career outcomes; instrument validity needs studies

tasks.name: Occupational information lookup
tasks.definition: Given a job title or occupation, return its tasks, requirements, wages and outlook and related occupations.
tasks.inputs: job title or occupation code
tasks.outputs: occupation profiles, related occupations
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: coding free-text job titles to occupation codes is scored against hand-coded samples

tasks.name: Transferable skills analysis
tasks.definition: Given a worker's past jobs and functional limitations, identify occupations they can still perform.
tasks.inputs: work history, residual functional capacity
tasks.outputs: ranked feasible occupations with rationale
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: results can be compared with vocational expert decisions; no public dataset

tasks.name: College and career plan management
tasks.definition: Given a student's goals, coursework and test scores, build multi-year course plans and college lists and track applications.
tasks.inputs: goals, academic record, test scores, program requirements
tasks.outputs: course plans, college lists, application status
onet_products: College Central Network Career Services Central
tasks.benchmarkable: partly: admission-likelihood estimates can be scored on historical outcomes; the plans themselves cannot

handoffs.why: agreed with media: media.language.machine_translation and media.language.computer_assisted_translation; learn keeps dictionaries and language learning

handoffs.what: General text search (dtSearch, Internet search engine software)

handoffs.why: general mass messaging

handoffs.what: School meal point of sale (PCS Revenue Control Systems FASTRAK School Meal Software)
handoffs.why: point of sale

handoffs.why: HR; only the learning module is modeled here

open_questions: Assistive technology: screen readers and magnifiers are general accessibility tools filed by O*NET under device drivers. Keep them in learn, or move the capability to computing and keep only braille and reading support here?
Required training assignment and tracking (corporate compliance learning) straddles enterprise HR. It is kept in learn.course_delivery.
Psychometric calibration (item response theory) is kept in learn.assessment rather than science statistics because it is specific to tests; confirm.

Archives and museums (learn.archives_collections) and career guidance (learn.career_guidance) are new capabilities read into 'keep knowledge' and school counseling; confirm they belong here rather than in media (digital asset management) or enterprise (HR).
see_also ids pointing at other domains are guesses at their capability ids and need reconciling once all domains are in.
